title: DoubleCCA: Improving Foundation Model Group Robustness with Random Sentence Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image classification performance by measuring the average accuracy and worst-group robustness on the Waterbirds dataset, where the image background (e.g., land vs. water) acts as a spurious attribute correlated with the class.
Evaluating zero-shot image classification performance by measuring the average accuracy and worst-group robustness on the CelebA dataset across gender attributes (male and female).
Evaluating zero-shot image classification performance by measuring the average accuracy and worst-group robustness on the CelebA dataset across age attributes (young and old).

Evaluating zero-shot image classification performance by measuring the average accuracy and worst-group robustness on the CelebA dataset across racial attributes (white skin, dark skin, Asian, and others).
